name: openinterstate-reachability
title: OpenInterstate Reachability
description: Drive-time reachability scores between US interstate exits and nearby places, computed with OSRM against an OpenInterstate release.

licenses.name: ODbL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

resources.name: reachability
resources.description: OSRM driving distance, duration, and a score per exit-place pair.

fields.name: exit_id
fields.description: Exit being scored. Joins corridor_exits.exit_id in the core release.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Place being scored. Joins places.place_id in the core release.

fields.name: route_distance_m
fields.description: OSRM driving distance in meters. Empty when the pair is unreachable.

fields.name: route_duration_s
fields.description: OSRM driving time in seconds. Empty when the pair is unreachable.

fields.name: reachable
fields.description: Whether OSRM found a driving route between the pair (t or f).

fields.name: reachability_score
fields.description: 0 to 100, higher is easier to reach. Penalized by route distance and exit-to-place offset. 0 when unreachable.

fields.name: reachability_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the score from 0 to 1. Decreases with route distance.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Routing engine that scored the pair, currently osrm.

fields.name: provider_dataset_version
fields.description: Provider dataset version when recorded. May be empty.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the pair was scored, UTC.

resources.name: osrm_snap_hints
resources.description: Snapped coordinates and routing hints for incremental scoring runs.

fields.name: source_scope
fields.description: Source scope for the endpoint, like product.

fields.name: endpoint_kind
fields.description: Kind of snapped endpoint, like exit.

fields.name: endpoint_id
fields.description: OSM-derived identifier of the endpoint.

fields.name: dataset_key
fields.description: Key for the snapping dataset and config that produced the hint.

fields.name: input_lon
fields.description: Original longitude before snapping, WGS84.

fields.name: input_lat
fields.description: Original latitude before snapping, WGS84.

fields.name: snapped_lon
fields.description: Longitude snapped onto the routable road network.

fields.name: snapped_lat
fields.description: Latitude snapped onto the routable road network.

fields.name: hint
fields.description: Opaque OSRM hint token reused to skip re-snapping on later runs.

fields.name: snapped_distance_m
fields.description: Distance moved from the input point to the snapped point in meters.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the hint was produced, UTC.
